items.title: FortiSandbox 认证绕过致远程命令执行
items.title_zh: FortiSandbox 认证绕过致远程命令执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者构造恶意 HTTP 请求绕过认证路径，以设备权限执行任意代码或命令
items.affected: Fortinet(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制管理接口公网暴露并排查异常 HTTP 请求
items.repro_note: 未授权构造 HTTP 请求走备用路径绕过认证，再注入命令执行
items.impact_scope: Fortinet 安全设备，常暴露公网与管理网
items.description: An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSandbox 5.0.0 through 5.0.6, FortiSandbox 4.4.0 through 4.4.9, FortiSandbox 4.2 all versions, FortiSandbox PaaS 5.0.0 through 5.0.6, FortiSandbox PaaS 4.4 all versions, FortiSandbox PaaS 4.2 all versions may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests

items.title: Mautic 活动导入任意文件上传致 RCE
items.title_zh: Mautic 活动导入任意文件上传致 RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备活动导入权限的已认证用户上传恶意文件，在按目录生效配置的 Apache 上以 Web 权限执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；临时收紧活动导入权限或关闭该功能
items.repro_note: 认证后经 campaign 导入上传含目录配置与脚本的文件，访问触发执行
items.impact_scope: 营销自动化平台，存联系人数据与应用密钥
items.description: An unrestricted file upload vulnerability exists in the campaign import feature of Mautic 7. On web servers that honor per-directory configuration, such as the default Apache setup of the official Mautic Docker image, this leads to remote code execution with the privileges of the web server user, including access to the Mautic configuration, application secrets, and contact data.

items.title: NexoPOS 更新接口目录遍历
items.title_zh: NexoPOS 更新接口目录遍历
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过 api/update 接口的路径参数穿越目录，读取或覆盖服务器上的任意敏感文件
items.action_zh: 升级至 6.2.5 或更高版本，并限制 api/update 接口访问来源
items.repro_note: 向 /api/update 的路径类参数注入 ../ 序列读取或写入任意文件
items.impact_scope: 零售 POS 系统，门店内网部署为主
items.description: NexoPOS v6.2.4 is vulnerable to Directory Traversal via the api/update endpoint.

items.title: danmu_api 默认令牌缺失认证致配置篡改
items.title_zh: danmu_api 默认令牌缺失认证致配置篡改
items.summary_zh: 使用默认 TOKEN 且未设 ADMIN_TOKEN 时，未认证者调 /api/env/* 改配置、锁管理员并触发 SSRF
items.action_zh: 升级至 1.21.7，务必设置自定义 ADMIN_TOKEN 并弃用默认令牌
items.repro_note: 未授权 POST /api/env/set，前置为默认 TOKEN 且 ADMIN_TOKEN 未设置
items.impact_scope: 自建弹幕聚合服务，常直接暴露公网
items.description: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment configuration when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/env/set, /api/env/add, or /api/env/del to set ADMIN_TOKEN, lock out operators, redirect OTHER_SERVER or PROXY_URL for SSRF, and trigger redeployment.

items.title: WolfProt 接口命令注入致未授权 RCE
items.title_zh: WolfProt 接口命令注入致未授权 RCE
items.summary_zh: 网络可达的未认证攻击者向受影响服务注入系统命令，以应用服务权限执行任意操作系统命令
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；临时限制该接口的网络访问范围
items.repro_note: 未授权访问 WolfProt 服务接口，在命令拼接参数中注入 shell 元字符
items.impact_scope: WolfProt 接口服务，暴露面待现场核查
items.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the WolfProt interface implementation. Insufficient neutralization of user-controlled input could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to a vulnerable service to execute operating-system commands with the privileges of the affected application service.

items.title: wsserver 终端桥命令注入致 root 执行
items.title_zh: wsserver 终端桥命令注入致 root 执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经 WebSocket 传入未过滤字段，在 root 权限守护进程中被拼接执行任意系统命令
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制 wsserver 端口暴露并关闭公钥会话免校验路径
items.repro_note: 连接 wsserver WebSocket，在会话字段注入命令元字符并走公钥路径免校验
items.impact_scope: 设备终端桥守护进程，内网暴露
items.description: The root-privileged `wsserver` terminal-bridge daemon builds a shell command from client-supplied WebSocket fields and passes it to `system()` and `popen()` without quoting, escaping, or character-set validation. The daemon's public-key session path performs no appliance-session check.

items.title: vSolution 共享密钥致 root 登录
items.title_zh: vSolution 共享密钥致 root 登录
items.summary_zh: 持有配套私钥的攻击者利用共享加密信任配置，以 root 身份 SSH 登录已启用文件共享的主站设备
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；关闭文件共享功能并轮换相关密钥与信任配置
items.repro_note: 前置为主站启用文件共享且已获取对应私钥，再用其 SSH 以 root 登录
items.impact_scope: 会议室协作主站设备，内网部署
items.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the vSolution Matrix file sharing feature. A shared cryptographic trust configuration could allow an attacker who obtains the matching private key to authenticate to an affected device via SSH as root. This vulnerability affects only devices configured as a vSolution Matrix main/master station with the file sharing feature enabled.
